Apply.dc.html.title: Apply · the plan and the result

t2.text: Preview every screen, then apply as one transaction

n1.text:
Colors: universal-themes/ui-kit-yellow-gray-yello.jpg — #1E2233 window, #252A3E surface, #2B3044 raised, one yellow accent #FFC700. The wallpaper carries the color; the chrome stays neutral.

The Apply artboard's step list is the base script (reference/apply-08-screen-wallpaper.sh) turned into a plan: render, copy to a greeter-readable path, set the greeter keys, generate the Plymouth theme, update-alternatives, GRUB drop-in, one initramfs rebuild, one update-grub, verify.

Screens shows detection, not assumption — the same build serves Mint, Ubuntu, Debian, Kubuntu, Xubuntu, MX and the rest.
